result.summary: Several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, cut-off cards at the edges, and incomplete visible content that make the page look broken.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is heavily truncated on the right edge, cutting off both the image and the name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels show partial peek of the next card with consistent padding, or fully contain cards within the viewport without clipping text.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text overflow ellipsis (or two-line clamp) so names remain legible when space is limited.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; a partial empty chip is visible on the far right, suggesting more categories without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add clear horizontal scroll indication or ensure chips wrap/fit without showing a cut-off empty pill.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, so the restaurant name and details below the image are not visible in the current frame.
issues.suggestion: Allow natural scroll and ensure list items aren’t awkwardly clipped; keep enough bottom padding above the tab bar.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over food images with varying contrast; on lighter plates the white pill can reduce legibility of the time text.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or darker scrim behind time badges so text stays readable on all image backgrounds.
